headline: Simba Corp Targets 20% MG Vehicle Price Reductions via Kenyan Assembly
summary: Simba Corp, Kenya's exclusive MG distributor, plans to cut retail car prices by up to 20% by shifting from importing fully built units to domestic local assembly.
why: Domestic automotive assembly in East Africa benefits from tariff exemptions under regional trade agreements.

impacts.name: Simba Corp
impacts.why: Transitioning to local vehicle assembly lowers import tariff duties and supports unit sales.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
